{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float
# Remove commas and cast to float
completed['revenue'] = completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed['revenue'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
